canonical.upgradeCadence: monthly-review, pinned exact, one converging bump per cadence

exceptions.reason: The gateway itself. It is the OpenAI-compatible endpoint every other project calls, so it must talk to upstream providers directly. Another product owns this repository; issue #61 treats it as read-only.

The product trains and runs its own in-browser model. Its only hosted-model call is a Python evaluation harness pointed at OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and a JavaScript client package cannot apply there, so convergence would be meaningless.

followUps.note: rolepatch declares ai ^6.0.97 and @ai-sdk/openai-compatible ^2.0.41 as ranges rather than the pinned canonical versions. Converging it is a change in another repository and is deliberately out of scope for the audit PR; it is blocked on ratification of the canonical option.
A vendored .next/standalone/package.json restates the dependency set. The audit skips .next, node_modules, and dist so the stale copy never reaches a verdict.

ratifiedDecision: Every Fleet project that calls a hosted model goes through the free-ai gateway (ai-gateway.sassmaker.com) via its OpenAI-compatible paths. In JavaScript and TypeScript the client is the Vercel AI SDK at the pinned canonical versions. Runtimes without a JavaScript client still target the gateway; only the client library differs. Calling a provider API host directly is non-compliant regardless of which client library is used.
